title: Sustainable Schools
description: District sustainability sprint briefing; integrated planning for public dashboard launch.
subject: English

sub_topics.name: Dashboard embargo
sub_topics.hint: Who may share figures before launch.

sprint_data.audio_transcript:
[SCENE START]
[Quiet HVAC hum, chairs scrape]
Coordinator: Thanks everyone—we’re locking the Green Audit Sprint for Term 2 before the EDB site visit. Update your briefing sheets now.
Coordinator: First, baseline electricity—Building B averaged 68 kilowatt-hours last week per school day, not 72—please correct all slides.
Facilities: Overnight standby is still brutal: 14 projectors left on standby last Tuesday alone; that’s equivalent to printing roughly 9,000 worksheets annually at our tariff assumption.
Coordinator: Next, canteen—used cooking oil recycling is 220 litres this month, target 240 by month end.
Sustainability Rep: Paperless pilot—Form 5 English has moved 85 percent of worksheets to the LMS; Form 4 is only 40 percent, so we prioritise Form 4 training Wednesday after school.
Coordinator: Dashboard—public board goes live Friday 4:30 p.m.; until then data is embargoed except to committee leads.
Parent Liaison: PTA wants alumni solar film for Block C, but Facilities says waterproofing must finish first—handover is now 21 October, not 14 October.
Coordinator: Volunteers—we need twelve student auditors; training runs 4:10 p.m. to 5:40 p.m.; capacity 18 seats, 20 have signed—please confirm overflow handling.
Coordinator: Escalation—if standby repeat offenders exceed 8 devices in a week, log Priority S to estates before Friday noon.
[SCENE END]

questions.question: Embargoed dashboard data means:
options: A. Only committee leads may circulate figures before Friday 4:30 p.m.

questions.question: Priority S logs when:
options: B. more than eight standby repeat offenders in a week
D. cooking oil hits target early

integrated_data.audio_transcript:
[INTEGRATED BRIEFING START]
Chair: Cross-school meeting on audit transparency—focus on uneven campuses.
EPD Liaison: Correction: district average standby waste is 11 devices per week, not 8—update KPI language.
Principal A: Small campuses need template dashboards even without sub-metering—proxy indicators are acceptable.
Principal B: Parents confuse paperless with ‘no homework’—communications must stress workload is unchanged.
Student Rep: Use student narrators at Friday launch—not only numbers.
Chair: Measurable outcomes: (1) reduce standby counts by 20% in six weeks; (2) publish bilingual toolkits by week 8.
[INTEGRATED BRIEFING END]

writing_task.instruction: You are Student Sustainability Secretary. Write a memo to class teachers about Friday’s dashboard launch, corrected kWh, embargo rules, and how to reassure parents that paperless does not mean reduced homework.
writing_task.marking_criteria: Content (figures/embargo), Language (accuracy, tone), Organisation (clear directives), Appropriacy (teacher audience)

marking_key: State Friday 4:30 p.m. public launch and embargo until then.
Include corrected kWh 68 and standby district KPI 11 devices/week where relevant.
Explain Priority S threshold: >8 repeat standby offenders weekly before Friday noon.
Reassure parents: homework load unchanged; paperless = distribution mode.
Mention bilingual toolkits by week 8 / 20% standby reduction as outcomes.
Memo layout: identifiable context, concise actions.
